description: File Cleanup Bugfix - Fix orphaned file/directory removal in sync, normalize lockfile paths to relative, and add placed-file cleanup to Remove Baton

userStories.title: Extract reusable cleanup function to core
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a shared cleanup utility in @baton-dx/core so that both sync orphan removal and 'Remove Baton' use the same robust deletion logic for files and directories.
acceptanceCriteria: New file packages/core/src/lockfile/cleanup.ts with removePlacedFiles(filePaths: string[], projectRoot: string): Promise<number>
Function resolves each path relative to projectRoot (handle both relative and absolute input paths)
Function uses stat() to check if each path is a file or directory
For files: use unlink() to remove
For directories: use rm(path, { recursive: true, force: true }) to remove
Already-deleted paths (ENOENT) are silently skipped — no errors thrown
After removing each file/dir, walk up parent directories and rmdir() empty ones up to (but not including) projectRoot
Function returns count of successfully removed items
Exported from packages/core/src/lockfile/index.ts and packages/core/src/index.ts
Unit tests in cleanup.test.ts covering: file removal, directory removal, already-gone paths, empty parent directory cleanup, mixed absolute/relative paths
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Extract the empty-parent-directory-cleanup pattern from cleanupOrphanedFiles() in packages/cli/src/commands/sync.ts lines 279-292. The lockfile index.ts barrel export is at packages/core/src/lockfile/index.ts. Core public API is at packages/core/src/index.ts.

userStories.title: Normalize lockfile paths to relative
userStories.description: As a developer, I need all lockfile integrity keys to use relative paths (relative to project root) so that orphan detection comparisons are consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: In packages/cli/src/commands/sync.ts, where placeFile() results are tracked, convert result.path to relative using relative(projectRoot, result.path) before storing in placedFiles
Skill paths (already relative like .cursor/skills/skill-a) are not double-converted — use isAbsolute() check or normalize safely
IDE config paths (already relative) are not double-converted
File config paths (fileEntry.target, already relative) are not changed
The cleanupOrphanedFiles() resolver (orphanedPath.startsWith('/')) continues to handle both absolute and relative formats for backward compatibility with old lockfiles
Existing lockfile tests pass without modification
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: relative() is already imported in sync.ts from node:path. Look for lines where result.path from placeFile() is stored — around lines 1039 and 1100. placeFile() returns absolute paths via resolveAbsolutePath() in packages/core/src/placement/engine.ts.

userStories.title: Refactor sync cleanup to use shared function
userStories.description: As a developer, I need cleanupOrphanedFiles() to use the new shared removePlacedFiles() function from core, which fixes the directory removal bug (unlink fails on directories with EISDIR).
acceptanceCriteria: cleanupOrphanedFiles() in sync.ts calls removePlacedFiles() from @baton-dx/core instead of inline unlink() + rmdir() logic
Import removePlacedFiles from @baton-dx/core
Orphan detection logic (comparing previousPaths vs currentPaths using Set difference) stays in sync.ts — only the deletion step is delegated
User prompt flow (dry-run listing, --yes auto-confirm, interactive confirm) unchanged
Spinner and count reporting unchanged — use the count returned by removePlacedFiles()
The inline unlink/rmdir/parent-cleanup code (approximately lines 270-296) is replaced by a single removePlacedFiles() call
All existing tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This story depends on US-001 (removePlacedFiles must exist in core). The key change is replacing the try { unlink } catch block and the parent directory cleanup loop with a single removePlacedFiles(orphanedPaths, projectRoot) call. Must run bun run build before typecheck since CLI resolves core from dist/.

userStories.title: Add placed-file cleanup to Remove Baton
userStories.description: As a user, I want 'Remove Baton' to offer cleaning up all placed files so my project is left clean after removal.
acceptanceCriteria: In handleRemoveBaton() in packages/cli/src/commands/manage.ts, read baton.lock using readLock() from @baton-dx/core before deleting it
Extract all file paths from lockfile integrity entries — iterate lockfile.packages[*].integrity keys to collect all tracked paths
If lockfile exists and has placed files: show user the list of files that would be removed using p.log.info()
Ask 'Also remove N placed file(s)?' using p.confirm() — default false for safety
If confirmed: call removePlacedFiles() from @baton-dx/core to delete all placed files and report count
Then delete baton.yaml, baton.lock, and .baton/preferences.yaml (if exists) as before
If lockfile doesn't exist, is invalid, or has no integrity entries: skip cleanup step and only delete config files
Non-interactive mode (--yes flag): auto-confirm placed file removal
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: This story depends on US-001 (removePlacedFiles). Use readLock() from packages/core/src/lockfile/manager.ts — it returns a parsed lockfile object. The lockfile schema is at packages/core/src/schemas/lockfile.ts. handleRemoveBaton() is at approximately line 234 in manage.ts. The existing function only does: unlink baton.yaml, unlink baton.lock. Add the cleanup BEFORE deleting baton.lock (since we need to read it first).
